### Curbline Properties Declares Common Stock Dividend of $0.17 for Third Quarter 2026


September 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/417291320/files/doc_news/2026/09/3Q26-Common-Dividend-Press-Release_vF.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Curbline Properties Corp. (NYSE: CURB), an owner of convenience centers in suburban, high household income communities, declared today a third quarter 2026 dividend on its common stock of $0.17 per share. The dividend is payable on October 14, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 29, 2026.


**About Curbline Properties** Curbline Properties is an owner and manager of convenience shopping centers positioned on the curbline of well-trafficked intersections and major vehicular corridors in suburban, high household income communities. The Company is a self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT) that is publicly traded under the ticker symbol “CURB” on the NYSE. Additional information about Curbline is available at[curbline.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcurbline.com%2F&esheet=54605607&newsitemid=20260916086346&lan=en-US&anchor=curbline.com&index=1&md5=0ee16886c57f9a64c188c87eea462631) . To be included in the Company’s e-mail distributions for press releases and other investor news, please click[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.curbline.com%2Fresource%2Finvestor-email-alerts%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54605607&newsitemid=20260916086346&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=0af062b387bfcd9d7b4ffafd8b3c4f3a) .
